prompt: A hyper-realistic photograph of a breathtaking female extraterrestrial on her lush, bioluminescent homeworld. Her features are an elegant fusion of human and alien--strikingly beautiful with iridescent skin that subtly reflects the soft glow of exotic plant life around her. Her elongated eyes shimmer with intelligence, and delicate facial ridges add to her ethereal allure. She stands amidst a verdant landscape teeming with alien flora--towering luminescent trees, cascading waterfalls with shimmering mist, and glowing vines that pulse with organic energy. Strange winged creatures flutter in the air, casting soft shadows against a twin-moon sky. The atmosphere is alive with vibrant colors, and the air glows with floating motes of light. The image is captured as if taken by an interstellar explorer, offering an awe-inspiring glimpse into a world beyond Earth. --ar 9:16 --stylize 750 --v 6.1
